description: This file defines the ModBinary class in Twig, representing the modulus binary operation within Twig's expression language. It extends the AbstractBinary class and implements the operator method to output the '%' operator.

classes.name: ModBinary
classes.description: Represents the modulus operator ( % ) in Twig's expression syntax, extending AbstractBinary and defining the operator method to output '%' during compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw '%' operator to be used in the compiled PHP code representing the modulus operation.
